title: Cosmic Grid Oracle
description: A hooded figure with a glowing spherical head featuring a smiley face and star eyes stands centered, wearing a red hood and a dark cloak patterned with a golden grid filled with stars and nebulae. The figure holds a small glowing orb with red liquid dripping from it, set against a dark background with a large circular mechanical halo structure.
